text: {"features":[{"name":"Role insight","description":"How clearly the letter shows an accurate, concrete understanding of this role's mission to scale security through automation, vulnerability handling, lifecycle integration, and agentic tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in software or security, with little sign of understanding what this team actually builds or enables."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions one relevant theme such as security, Google scale, or backend work, but leaves the role itself mostly generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects prior work to security automation or development-lifecycle security in general terms without addressing much of the specific charter."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Addresses multiple core parts of the charter, such as vulnerability handling, secure defaults, internal tooling, or Go back ends with Python agents."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced understanding of the mission as building agentic security systems that automate vulnerability response and help developer teams embed security at organizational scale."}]},{"name":"Professional experience depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates sustained hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents only the baseline profile, typically around three years of experience with a small number of launched services and limited scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows modest depth, such as three years with broader service exposure or five years with relatively narrow launch ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-level depth, typically around five years with clear experience across testing, maintenance, and launch of multiple services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong depth, typically five to seven years with multiple launches and some sense of progression in responsibility or ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive relevant depth, typically seven years or equivalent with repeated production ownership across many services and clear progression from maintenance into broader delivery ownership."}]},{"name":"Go backend fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter presents Go as a language of substantial back-end ownership rather than a box checked.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or as one language among others, with no sense of meaningful ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go is a primary or daily language but gives little evidence of what the applicant builds with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear production use of Go in real services or systems, making the experience feel credible and relevant."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Ties Go directly to designing, implementing, operating, or constraining back-end systems central to the applicant's work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the core language behind substantial back-end ownership, with repeated evidence of designing and running important services or control layers."}]},{"name":"Python engineering fluency","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates production-relevant Python experience for automation, services, or agent layers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it so vaguely that practical ability is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly, often only as an associated tool or agent language, without concrete ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for tooling, automation, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python ownership across services or automation that other engineers rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a core engineering language spanning production services, automation, analysis, and agent implementations."}]},{"name":"Agentic tooling ownership","description":"How clearly the letter shows direct experience designing systems built around autonomous or semi-autonomous agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of agentic-system work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or agentic tooling in generic terms without explaining design responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct involvement in building agentic systems, usually pairing agents with supporting infrastructure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains how the agentic system is structured, such as bounded actions, supervision, permissions, or auditable behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of agentic architecture with thoughtful control mechanisms that make the autonomy feel technically mature and relevant."}]},{"name":"Applied AI credibility","description":"How credibly the letter presents hands-on experience using modern AI systems in production-relevant settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or language models only vaguely, without evidence of shipped work or technical responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States that the applicant shipped model-backed or LLM-backed functionality in a real setting."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Pairs shipped AI work with concrete attention to evaluation, reliability, hardening, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production-minded AI experience that treats trustworthiness, constraints, and operational behavior as first-class engineering concerns."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on experience assessing the security of systems or designs.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no concrete evidence of doing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security reviews or assessments briefly but without scope, method, or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes recognizable assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or review of existing services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows structured assessment practice with clear ownership and attention to remediation or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents repeated, hands-on security assessment work across designs or services, communicated with an attacker-aware and implementation-level perspective."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation depth","description":"How well the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, handling, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability-response automation or only shows general interest in the topic."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automating security toil but gives no clear example of having done it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct involvement in building automation for vulnerability reports or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete response-workflow functions such as classification, deduplication, routing, prioritization, or reduced manual handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows ownership of an end-to-end vulnerability-response pipeline with clear workflow detail and strong evidence of operational impact."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no signal of algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in general terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports the claim with one specific example of choosing a better structure or algorithm for a real system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical fluency through a concrete redesign that materially improved performance, tractability, or correctness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking feel like a consistent strength by pairing strong self-positioning with especially crisp, high-leverage examples."}]},{"name":"Platform orientation","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation for foundational infrastructure work whose improvements propagate across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little sign of caring about foundational or organization-wide impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact generically without clearly preferring platform-style work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states that central infrastructure, quiet resilience, or broad leverage is appealing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly emphasizes the value of work whose benefits are inherited downstream by many teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames past choices and future goals around foundational systems whose improvements compound across an organization, making platform fit feel central rather than incidental."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How well the letter presents security work as enabling other engineers rather than merely policing them.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about the engineers who will use the tooling or adopts an impersonal security posture."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping teams in passing but without much sense of user-centered thinking."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in reducing toil or making secure behavior easier for other engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly focuses on removing friction, creating good defaults, or designing tools that busy developers will actually adopt."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently centers internal users, showing nuanced empathy for developer workflows and a service mindset toward secure-by-default tooling."}]},{"name":"Reliability mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys a bias toward correctness, maintainability, guardrails, and long-term operability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers little evidence of a quality bar beyond general enthusiasm."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes broad claims about rigor or standards without concrete practices or examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses a clear concern for quiet resilience, higher standards, maintainer instincts, or bounded systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects that concern to concrete practices such as typed and tested tooling, audited actions, careful releases, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes correctness, maintainability, and safe constraints a defining theme of the letter, reinforced with multiple concrete examples."}]},{"name":"Offensive security credibility","description":"How much the letter shows credible attacker-oriented practice through certifications, capture-the-flag participation, or equivalent evidence.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no real signal of offensive-security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a light signal, such as a basic security certification or casual mention of occasional practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful attacker-perspective engagement through regular capture-the-flag participation or a clear foundational credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong offensive credibility through an advanced credential such as OSCP or notably strong capture-the-flag performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional offensive credibility through OSCP plus strong competitive results or an equally compelling pattern of sustained advanced practice."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"How much the letter demonstrates self-directed engineering ownership beyond assigned day-job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no meaningful evidence of self-directed building or stewardship outside stated work duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small personal utility, a minor side build, or occasional upstream fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a sustained but modest side project or recurring open-source contribution with real ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows either an ambitious self-directed system build or active maintenance of an open-source project used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows both substantial self-directed engineering and clear stewardship of software used beyond the applicant personally or locally."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter backs its claims with concrete examples, details, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions and adjectives, leaving skills and impact largely unsubstantiated."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some specific facts such as years, tools, or titles but little concrete evidence of outcomes or responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses a few concrete examples or outcomes that make the claims partially testable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly supports claims with specific systems, actions, workflow details, or measurable impact."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds nearly every major claim in concrete evidence, making the case feel highly credible and easy to verify."}]},{"name":"Argument cohesion","description":"How effectively the letter organizes its content into a coherent, persuasive case for fit.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as disjointed or checklist-like, with little throughline connecting background to the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has basic structure but makes only a weak or uneven case for why this applicant fits this job."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a clear overall structure and links experience to the role at several points."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a strong case step by step, with the opening, evidence, and closing reinforcing one another."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially cohesive and persuasive argument in which the narrative arc and the evidence work together seamlessly."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the prose is at the level of spelling, grammar, and typographical accuracy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that noticeably distract from the content or undermine confidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains repeated noticeable errors, though the meaning remains easy enough to follow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains several scattered errors that do not materially interfere with comprehension."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Contains only a small number of noticeable slips in otherwise polished prose."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Contains at most one or two minor slips that are easy to overlook and never distracting."}]}]}
